verdict.rationale: Ollama is an LLM inference runtime, so paged KV-cache memory management is a fair performance axis. However, nothing in the evidence pack mentions paged attention, KV-cache paging, or fragmentation avoidance. The only related items are adjacent: running multiple models concurrently, cloud 'dedicated capacity' claims, and a community remark that native MLX may mean better memory handling on Apple silicon. None of these is the requested capability.

support.subject: As a developer, I can rely on paged memory management for attention key/value cache to maximize concurrent request capacity without memory fragmentation
